(2) Re-probed the F-043 hyphen-compound shape against the two allowlisted stems not covered by the existing fixture (chk-, sep-), plus uppercase-cased and repeated-stem variants; all correctly collapse (protected only when not hyphen-preceded). Audited the remaining 5 allowlisted prefixes for i-class instability (wholesale renumbering forced by the retry itself): chk- and f- are system-minted sequential plus append-only (checklist.ts:420, finding.ts:552); sep- is system-minted sequential plus append-only, decisions patch-in-place by id (scope-anti-expansion.ts); req- is immutable after first set (types.ts) and, per the story's own completeness guard, measured inert at its only render site (always past the 200-char prefix window) so it cannot currently cause a regression either way; bug- is caller-supplied but duplicate-id-guarded and append-only, with the fix path being bug_update (status mutate) not a re-report, so nothing forces renumbering on a mechanical retry, structurally unlike init_check_set's wholesale overwrite. None share the i- defect. (3) Confirmed tasks/gate-repeat-block-smoke.ts is byte-identical to main (diff exit 0) and its compiled suite exits 0. (4) Reproduced both mutations in isolated, throwaway git-worktree copies: M15 (leading guard weakened back to a bare word boundary) fails exactly 1 of 23 cases, embedded-test-output-hyphen-compounds; M14 (i- re-added to the allowlist) fails exactly 1 of 23 cases, init-check-issue-ordinal. Both matrix cases localize precisely to their guarded rule, no collateral failures.
